newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki to offer 32.1 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki to offer 32.1 million shares.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Monday it would offer 32.1 million shares, including 13 million new K shares, to institutions, the public and employees.
Some 28.1 million shares would be offered to institutions and four million to retail investors and personnel.

"As a result of the state's share sale and Rautaruukki's issue, the state stake in Rautaruukki will fall clearly below 50 percent and depending on the final amount of the state's sale, it could fall close to 40 percent," the statement said.

The arrangers had an option to raise the state's amount sold to institutions by 3.8 million shares and the ministry of trade and industry could increase the public offering by 3.4 million shares, Rautaruukki said.
The retail offering included one bonus share for every 10 shares bought in the offering after one year's holding, it said.
Some of the 13 million new shares would be offered directly to Finnish wholesale and retail group Kesko Oy to pay for Rautaruukki's purchase of Keskometalli Oy, it said.

"Rautaruukki will use the proceeds to finance the Rautaruukki 2000 investment programme and to satisfy the remaining consideration of 100 million markka for the acquisition of Keskometalli Oy payable in shares to Kesko Oy," it said.

The offering would be priced after book-building in late April, it said. The offering will be managed by SBC Warburg and Union Bank of Switzerland globally, with Merita Corporate Finance as domestic lead manager.
